After the API cancel: /admin/bookings?status=cancelled lists the booking, the detail action bar hides admin-booking-action-cancelled/completed/confirmed (terminal) while keeping admin-booking-gps-button, ledger picks up BOOKING_REFUND and COMMISSION_REVERSAL rows alongside the original DEBIT+ACCRUAL, history grows to 4 entries. Phase 4 Step 1 regressions still fine — /admin dashboard renders admin-dashboard-content, /admin/agents renders admin-agents-table, public / and /packages render (home hero + 4 packages).
critical_code_review_comments: core/booking_service.change_status performs cancel refund + commission reversal + booking update + audit as sequential single-doc writes with no MongoDB session/transaction; on partial failure (e.g., crash between BOOKING_REFUND insert and commission update) the ledger and the commissions.status field can diverge. Same class of issue flagged in Phase 4 Step 1 for financial_service. Once a replica set is available, wrap in an async session with_transaction. Idempotency keys (refund-{booking_id}, reversal-{commission_id}) partially mitigate replay but not the intermediate-crash scenario.

ChangeStatusDialog fires api.patch and closes optimistically; if the backend returns 400 (e.g., disallowed transition) the error is surfaced via setError but the dialog does NOT differentiate a validation 400 from a 5xx — main agent may want per-error copy for the state-machine rejection.

AdminBookingsPage filter tabs render an inline-flex container that overflows horizontally on narrow screens (overflow-x-auto is set — OK) but the sticky admin shell header can cover the top of the search input on tablet widths; not a blocker.

admin_bookings.list_bookings does 3 batch find() calls for agents/packages/customers after the main query — fine at current data volume, but consider $lookup or a projection once bookings scale into thousands.
GpsDialog does not disable the Save button when gps equals current status; backend handles the no-op via changed=false but a client-side guard would avoid the extra round trip.
The reason/note field in ChangeStatusDialog has no character counter though the Pydantic max_length=400 will 422 silently — minor UX.
